description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output, with a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a dashed black line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, with an average value of 0.03, which remains relatively stable around 0.03 across the x-axis; a dotted orange line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, with an average value of 0.44, which starts at approximately 0.95 at layer 0, decreases sharply to around 0.2 at layer 5, and then gradually declines to about 0.1 at layer 20; and a dashed green line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, with an average value of 0.33, which begins at around 0.7 at layer 0, drops to approximately 0.1 at layer 5, and then remains relatively stable around 0.1 until layer 20.
